title: fix(record-page): each task action drawn once with a reason on the greyed Archive; one date format, aligned cards and readable comments
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoS1PGrJjJvkgDrLpK8ck5SJ)_

Part of #27520 (rows 9 and 14, the record page; the card's other rows are landed or carded elsewhere, and the seat closes it)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：任务记录页的动作只画一次（页头一排；正文按钮条只放页头不画的「Recalculate Estimate」），灰掉的 Archive 说明原因「Mark the task done first.」（中文「请先将任务标记为完成。」）；项目记录页日期统一带年份、追加的附件卡片/页脚与页面卡片对齐、评论正文改用前景色。
- 为什么改：18.3.0 RC 走查第 9、14 行：同一组按钮出现两次、禁用提示只说「Not available for this record」、同一页两种日期格式、附件卡片比其他卡片宽、评论文字灰得看不清。第 9 行两半都出自 showcase 示例自身的元数据（页面重复声明、动作未写 disabledReason），按契约优先改生产者，不在渲染器里去重。
- 风险与回滚：渲染侧只改 3 处显示（详情区日期带年份、追加区块加水平内边距、评论正文颜色），不改任何契约或数据；showcase 动作的 locations 调整后六个位置仍各有宿主，平台清单 action-location-matrix 同步改写。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/task-detail.page.ts` 与 `src/ui/actions/index.ts` 的 locations；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 的 `RECORD_PAGE_APPEND_INSET`；`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` 的 `alwaysShowYear`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm dev` 后打开任意未完成任务：页头 Mark Done / Log Time / Archive 各一个，正文只有 Recalculate Estimate，悬停 Archive 看到「Mark the task done first.」；打开项目 Website Relaunch：Start Date 读作「Oct 2, 2026」，Attachments 卡片与上方卡片同宽。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Row 9, task record page (showcase example metadata, the producer):**
- `task-detail.page.ts` drew Mark Done, Log Time and Archive twice: its `page:header` lists them and its `record:quick_actions` bar named the same three. The bar now names the task's `record_section` set alone, `showcase_recalc_estimate`, which the header does not draw. A renderer dedupe would have overridden an explicit `kind: 'full'` composition, so the page is fixed instead.
- `actions/index.ts`: Mark Done, Log Time and Archive drop `record_section`; Recalculate Estimate declares `record_section` only (it was `record_more` + `record_section`), so it is drawn once, in the bar, not again under the header overflow. Every record location keeps a stock host on `showcase_task` (header: the three; overflow: open_docs, recalc_selection; related: log_time; section: recalc_estimate).
- `ArchiveTaskAction` declares `disabledReason: 'Mark the task done first.'` (the `ActionSchema.disabledReason` door), plus the zh-CN copy key. The console drew the generic fallback only because the specimen declared none.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`, `records-forms.action-location-matrix`: fixtures.requires, the record_section variant and the CLOSED-gap note re-pointed to the new hosts; revision 18.

**Row 14, project record page (renderer):**
- `plugin-detail` `DetailSection`: a section row passes `alwaysShowYear` to the date cell, as `HeaderHighlight` already does, so the strip ("Dec 31, 2026") and a section ("Oct 2" before, "Oct 2, 2026" now) read one way. Grid cells keep the face that drops the current year. One call site.
- `app-shell` `RecordDetailView`: the appends drawn after an authored page (Approvals fallback, Attachments fallback, provenance footer) take the page body's horizontal inset (`px-3 md:px-4 lg:px-6`, the `page` renderer's padding), so they no longer draw 24 px wider on each side.
- `plugin-detail` `RecordActivityTimeline`: a feed entry's body uses `text-foreground` (was `text-muted-foreground`), as a reply's body already does; the meta line stays muted.

## Tests

- New: `plugin-detail` `DetailSection.dateYear-27520` (3: section with year, strip and section alike, grid control), `RecordActivityTimeline.commentBodyContrast-27520` (2: body foreground, meta-line control), `app-shell` `RecordDetailView.appendInset-27520` (2: Attachments fallback and footer carry the inset read off the real page root), showcase `archive-disabled-reason` (2), and in showcase `record-action-location-hosts` a record_section block (3: bar parses and names the whole record_section set, no action drawn by both header and bar) plus "every record location keeps a stock host".
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty: drop `alwaysShowYear` in DetailSection, 2 failed / 1 passed; body back to muted, 1 failed / 1 passed; inset constant emptied, 2 failed; delete the `disabledReason` line, 1 failed / 1 passed; bar names the three header actions again, 2 failed / 11 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- Row 9's two halves were measured as producer facts, not renderer gaps: the `disabledReason` door already exists and every action surface falls back to the generic text only when it is absent.
- Removing the bar outright (the first proposal) would have left `record_section` with no stock host, which the P1 checklist item requires; the seat chose to keep the bar on an action the header does not draw.
- `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts`'s `legacy_row_actions` comment still says recalc_estimate is declared at "`record_more` / `record_section`"; it is now `record_section` only. The comment's point (not a `list_item` action) still holds; the file is outside this PR's surface.
- The showcase's other `disabled` specimen, `showcase_zoo_disabled_gate`, still declares no `disabledReason`; row 9 named the task's Archive only.
- On the project page the Attachments fallback reads "Loading attachments…" until it scrolls into view; that is the deliberate lazy read, not a stuck load.
- `RecordDetailView.tsx` is also touched by PR #28490 (the delete confirm); the hunks do not overlap.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live re-measure on main 9b4d1933 and after-read at this branch (showcase --fresh, admin, 1440x900, Console from source)</summary>

Before (main): task page buttons Mark Done / Log Time / Archive in the header and again in the body; Archive aria-describedby "Not available for this record". Project page: highlights "Dec 31, 2026", section "Oct 2"; Attachments card x=280 w=1136 against the other cards x=304 w=1088; comment body class `text-muted-foreground`, rgb(100, 116, 139).

After (this branch): task page header Mark Done / Log Time / Archive, body Recalculate Estimate only; Archive aria-describedby "Mark the task done first.". Project page: "Dec 31, 2026" and "Oct 2, 2026"; Attachments x=304 w=1088; comment body `text-foreground`, rgb(2, 8, 23).
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs (head beac4b23; the package suites ran at 6b17724f, and the later commits add the changeset and a merge of origin/main 8c3f9d93)</summary>

- After merging origin/main (8c3f9d93, which brought PR #28490's RecordDetailView hunk), every `RecordDetailView*` test plus the two new plugin-detail tests reran: 94 files, 587 tests passed (VERDICT command-exit 0).

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/` under the lock: Test Files 357 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 3172 passed, 18 skipped (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- App-shell and console record-page slice (every `RecordDetailView*` test plus each test importing plugin-detail, `DetailSection` or `RecordActivityTimeline`): 116 files, 862 tests passed (VERDICT command-exit 0). The whole app-shell suite is left to CI.
- `pnpm --dir examples/app-showcase run test`: 42 files, 511 tests passed. `typecheck` exit 0. `objectstack validate` exit 0, no warning names a changed action.
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 60 derived, each run with stdin from /dev/null; `--ran`: 60 derived, 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 7 packages without dist); after building them it exited 0. Includes `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0, `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exit 0, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (169 files passed, 2 skipped).
- `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new. eslint on the changed files: 0 errors.
</details>
